correctness.rationale: Specializing the published edge criterion to consecutive layers gives exactly add/delete edges between adjacent weights and same-layer swaps only at weights \(a\) and \(b\). The submitted proof constructs paths of the three stated lengths \(H,L,U\). For the reverse inequality, \(D_B=\min(H,L,U)\) is one-Lipschitz on every edge: all candidates change by at most one on add/delete edges; on the lower boundary \(H-L=a-r\ge0\), and on the upper boundary \(H-U=q-r\ge0\), leaving the minimum of the two boundary candidates, each changing by at most one under a swap. Hence \(D_B\) is a valid lower-bound potential. Complement symmetry and explicit endpoint pairs then give diameter \(\min(b,d-a)\). Independent finite replay through small dimensions agrees with the closed formula and is corroborative only.
risks: The theorem is restricted to consecutive cardinality intervals; arbitrary gapped S are not covered.
